accessLocation: Shorts Bar Recreation Site, Lower Salmon River, Idaho
decisionScope: BLM publishes the exact stored coordinate (to rounding) and describes Shorts Bar as a frequent Lower Salmon put-in with easy river access. Its official boater guide lists a boat ramp, campsites, and toilets. The access site identity and access area are verified; the wet-toe coordinate is not separately surveyed. The shared Island Bar control also received a Salmon River / Lower Salmon River name alias so both BLM recreation anchors are recognized on the Lower Salmon route records.

change.rationale: BLM current recreation-site coordinates match the route point; added official site control and river-name alias. The one suspicious Shorts Bar occurrence now reviews as an authoritative access-area anchor. The two river-site anchors on the Island Bar-to-Shorts Bar route now also resolve to review.

remainingUncertainty: The BLM site marker is an access-area coordinate rather than a surveyed wet toe. Two targeted route reports have one unrelated/incomplete NHD source query each. On the Carey Creek-to-Riggins route, a separate access point remains suspicious at 427 ft from its matched flowline and needs independent evidence review.
outcome: The selected suspicious Shorts Bar occurrence moved to review with no coordinate move. Three Shorts Bar route occurrences match the BLM location; the related Island Bar endpoint also now matches an official control.
